title: Donner une distance, une mesure et une fraction
summary: Locate places with à ... de, describe dimensions and express useful fractions and halves.
objectives: Locate a place a measured distance from another.
Express length, width, height, weight and capacity naturally.
Read fractions and distinguish demi before and after a noun.

sources.label: B1 public topic index (coverage reference only)
Wiktionary: demi as a fractional noun

sections.title: A location is à a distance de a reference point
paragraphs: Use être/se trouver à + distance + de + reference point: Le centre est à deux kilomètres de la gare. À introduces the distance; de introduces the place you measure from. Contract de with articles when necessary: du musée, des bureaux; elide before a vowel: d'ici.

A travel time can replace kilometres in ordinary location descriptions: à dix minutes à pied de la gare. This tells the reader the mode of travel; ten minutes by car and ten minutes walking are not interchangeable.
points: Vocabulary: un kilomètre (masculine), a kilometre; une gare (feminine), a station; un musée (masculine), a museum.

examples.french: Le local est **à** trois kilomètres **du** centre-ville.
examples.english: The premises are three kilometres from the town centre.

examples.french: Nous sommes **à** cinq minutes à pied **de** la gare.
examples.english: We are a five-minute walk from the station.
examples.note: The transport mode makes the time estimate useful.

examples.french: Le distributeur est **à** deux cents mètres **d'ici**.
examples.english: The cash machine is two hundred metres from here.

mistakes.avoid: Le centre est trois kilomètres de la gare.
mistakes.prefer: Le centre est à trois kilomètres de la gare.
mistakes.why: A measured location needs à before the distance.

sections.title: Length is de long; a weight uses peser
paragraphs: For dimensions, use a measurement with de long, de large, de haut, de profondeur or de diamètre, as appropriate: une table de deux mètres de long; la table fait deux mètres de long. Long, large and haut remain fixed masculine forms in these measurement expressions, even after a feminine noun.

Mesurer and faire can express size: elle mesure un mètre soixante-dix, she is 1.70 metres tall. Peser expresses weight; contenir or avoir une capacité de describes volume capacity. Avoid a word-for-word English is with a bare number: use la table mesure deux mètres, not la table est deux mètres.

Vocabulary: un mètre (masculine), a metre; un centimètre (masculine), a centimetre; un kilogramme (masculine), a kilogram; un litre (masculine), a litre. Unit symbols such as m, cm, kg and L do not take plural s. In French numerals, a decimal comma is usual: 1,5 m.
points: A natural spoken height can omit a second unit: un mètre soixante-dix means one metre and seventy centimetres.
A volume and a weight measure different things; a litre is not always a kilogram.

examples.french: La table fait deux mètres **de long** et quatre-vingts centimètres **de large**.
examples.english: The table is two metres long and eighty centimetres wide.
examples.note: The fixed expressions do not agree with feminine table.

examples.french: Cette étagère **mesure** un mètre quatre-vingts **de haut**.
examples.english: This shelf is one metre eighty centimetres high.

examples.french: Le colis **pèse** trois kilos; le réservoir **contient** dix litres.
examples.english: The parcel weighs three kilos; the tank contains ten litres.
examples.note: Weight and volume use suitable verbs.

mistakes.avoid: Une table de deux mètres de longue.
mistakes.prefer: Une table de deux mètres de long.
mistakes.why: De long is a fixed measurement expression, not an adjective agreeing with table.

sections.title: A count of equal parts
paragraphs: For an ordinary fraction, name the top number, the numerator, with a cardinal number and the bottom number, the denominator, with a fractional name. Special common forms are un demi (1/2), un tiers (1/3), un quart (1/4), deux tiers (2/3), trois quarts (3/4). From fifths onward, use an ordinal-style name: un cinquième, deux cinquièmes, trois huitièmes, neuf dixièmes. The denominator normally takes plural s when the numerator is greater than one; tiers already ends in s.

Use de before the whole being divided: les trois quarts du budget, un tiers des places. La moitié de means half of and often sounds more natural than un demi de before an ordinary noun. Vocabulary: une moitié (feminine), a half; un tiers (masculine), a third; un quart (masculine), a quarter.

Before a noun, demi is invariable and linked by a hyphen: un demi-litre, une demi-heure, deux demi-heures. After a noun with et, demi agrees in gender but not number: un litre et demi, deux litres et demi, une heure et demie, deux heures et demie. Midi et demi and minuit et demi use masculine demi. As a mathematical noun, demi has an ordinary plural: trois demis.
points: For example, three eighths is trois huitièmes, not trois huit.
A half quantity such as une demi-heure and a total such as une heure et demie are different amounts.

examples.french: **Les trois quarts du** budget sont déjà utilisés.
examples.english: Three quarters of the budget have already been used.
examples.note: Quarts takes s; de + le becomes du.

examples.english: Two fifths of the places are reserved.
examples.note: Cinquièmes is plural; des is de + les here.

examples.french: La visite dure **une heure et demie**.
examples.english: The visit lasts an hour and a half.
examples.note: Demie takes feminine e but not plural s.

examples.english: Add half a litre of water.
examples.note: Demi before the noun is invariable and hyphenated.

sections.title: Mesure fixe ou adjectif qui s'accorde
paragraphs: Two dimension constructions place the describing word differently. After a measurement, de long, de large and de haut stay fixed; the noun alternatives are de longueur, de largeur and de hauteur. Depth uses de profondeur, not de profond. With être + adjective + de + measurement, however, the adjective describes the subject and agrees: la fosse est profonde de deux mètres.

Keep the full agreement patterns available: haut, haute, hauts, hautes; long, longue, longs, longues; large, large, larges, larges; profond, profonde, profonds, profondes, in masculine singular, feminine singular, masculine plural and feminine plural order. First identify which construction you are using, then decide whether agreement applies.

Sur can link two dimensions, meaning by: quatre mètres sur trois. It joins side lengths; the resulting area is a separate calculation, here twelve square metres. Do not call each side douze mètres or confuse the side lengths with the area.
points: Vocabulary: une fosse (feminine), a pit; une longueur (feminine), a length; une largeur (feminine), a width; une hauteur (feminine), a height; une profondeur (feminine), a depth.

examples.french: Les fosses font deux mètres **de profondeur** ; elles sont **profondes de** deux mètres.
examples.english: The pits are two metres deep; they have a depth of two metres.
examples.note: The noun profondeur is fixed after the amount; the adjective profondes agrees before de.

examples.french: La rampe fait six mètres **de longueur** ; elle est **longue de** six mètres.
examples.english: The ramp is six metres in length; it is six metres long.
examples.note: La rampe fait six mètres de long is another natural wording without adjective agreement.

examples.french: L'abri fait quatre mètres **sur** trois, soit douze mètres carrés.
examples.english: The shelter measures four metres by three, or twelve square metres.
examples.note: Sur links two dimensions, not their sum.

sections.title: La fraction et le nombre du verbe
paragraphs: A singular fraction followed by a plural group can allow singular or plural verb agreement: un quart des élèves participe / participent. Singular agreement highlights the fraction as one portion; plural agreement highlights its members. Neither form should automatically be marked wrong in an otherwise open context.

Do not turn that choice into free agreement everywhere. A singular amount such as la moitié du réservoir is not a plural group of people; in La moitié du réservoir est vide, use singular est. And trois quarts already has a plural head in Les trois quarts sont réservés.
points: Check both the fractional expression and its complement before judging number.

examples.french: **Un tiers des logements dispose / disposent** d'un balcon.
examples.english: One third of the dwellings have a balcony.
examples.note: Either agreement can express the stated proportion; the example displays accepted alternatives.

examples.english: Half of the tank is empty.
examples.note: The singular quantity and singular complement do not create a plural group reading.

practice.prompt: Supply the preposition: Le village est ___ dix kilomètres de la mer.
practice.explanation: À introduces the measured distance.

practice.prompt: Supply de + le in contracted form: à trois kilomètres ___ musée.
practice.explanation: De + le becomes du.

practice.prompt: Complete the fixed length expression: une pièce de cinq mètres de ___.
practice.explanation: De long stays fixed regardless of pièce's gender.

practice.prompt: Write the fraction 3/4 in French words, without an article.
practice.explanation: Three parts out of four: trois quarts.

practice.prompt: Supply the elided from-here group: Le parc est à cent mètres ___.
practice.explanation: De becomes d' before ici.

practice.prompt: Supply the fixed adjective for width: Cette porte fait quatre-vingt-dix centimètres de ___.
practice.explanation: De large expresses width.

practice.prompt: Supply peser in the present: Ce sac ___ huit kilos.
practice.explanation: Use peser to express weight.

practice.prompt: Write 2/3 in French words, without an article.
practice.explanation: Tiers already ends in s.

practice.prompt: Write 3/8 in French words, without an article.
practice.explanation: Use the cardinal numerator and plural denominator.

practice.prompt: Supply demi in the correct form: deux heures et ___.
practice.explanation: After et, demi agrees in gender but not number.

practice.prompt: Write half an hour using une, demi and heure with the required joining.
practice.explanation: Pre-noun demi is invariable and hyphenated.

practice.prompt: Supply de + les in contracted form: un tiers ___ participants.
practice.explanation: The fraction is taken from the identified participants: de + les.

practice.prompt: Supply the fixed word for height: une tour de vingt mètres de ___.
practice.explanation: De haut remains masculine singular in the measurement phrase.

practice.prompt: Write 4/5 in French words, without an article.
practice.explanation: Cinquièmes is plural with a numerator greater than one.

practice.prompt: Supply demi in the correct form: trois litres et ___.
practice.explanation: Litre is masculine; post-noun demi does not take plural s.

practice.prompt: Supply the two prepositions in order, separated by a comma: Le gîte est ___ quinze minutes à pied ___ la gare.
practice.explanation: À introduces travel time; de introduces the reference location.

practice.prompt: Supply the agreed form of long: Les passerelles sont ___ de quinze mètres.
practice.explanation: In être + adjective + de + measurement, longues agrees with feminine plural passerelles.

practice.prompt: Complete the noun expression for depth: Le bassin fait un mètre de ___.
practice.explanation: After the measurement, use de profondeur; de profond is not this dimension construction.

practice.prompt: Write the French word meaning by between side lengths: La bâche fait sept mètres ___ deux.
practice.explanation: Sur joins length and width; here the corresponding rectangular area is fourteen square metres.

practice.prompt: Supply disposer in the present; either accepted number is allowed: Un quart des appartements ___ d'une cave.
practice.explanation: Singular agreement foregrounds the quarter as a portion; plural agreement foregrounds the apartments.

practice.prompt: Supply être in the present for this singular quantity: La moitié du gâteau ___ intacte.
practice.explanation: This subject refers to half of one cake and takes singular est.

production_task.prompt: Describe a room you might rent for an event. Give its distance from a station, its length and width, the fraction of the budget the rent would use, and a visit duration ending in et demie.
production_task.model_answer: La salle est à cinq minutes à pied de la gare. Elle fait huit mètres de long et six mètres de large. Le loyer utiliserait un tiers du budget. La visite durera une heure et demie.
production_task.translation: The room is a five-minute walk from the station. It is eight metres long and six metres wide. The rent would use one third of the budget. The visit will last an hour and a half.
rubric: Include both à and de in the distance expression.
Keep de long and de large fixed.
Use the appropriate fractional noun and de contraction.
Check demi's position and gender agreement.
